title: プログラミング入門
subtitle: Introduction to Programming
educationalGoal: Computer systems are constructions of hardware and software technology. This course focuses on the software side of the combination. Programming is the skill used to create software, and knowledge regarding it also helps users employ software effectively. Dealing with a typical programing language, C programing language, we will learn basic elements (input/output, data type, and array).
advice: Specifically, students in this course will learn about the following topics: ・Fundamental programming procedures ・Variable and data type ・Input/output, and arithmetic operation ・Array and string Using the development environment of C programing language, students will learn programming by actually creating programs written in the textbook, debugging them, and checking the results. The results of examinations will be reported to students, who will then be encouraged and required to use those results to improve their skills.
requiredKnowledge: The installation of the development environment will be covered during the first class and each student must establish the environment before the second class. Students will be expected to write source code during in the class, so advanced keyboard skills are expected.

activityGoals.body: Be able to create programs under development environment of C programming language.
Be able to execute instructions for Input/output.
Be able to understand the concept of data type.
Be able to understand the concept of array.
Be able to execute basic arithmetic calculations.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
